part.text:
Fixed in `caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go:315` — `finalizeHeredoc` now passes through blank lines (empty or `\r`-only) without requiring the closing-marker padding to match, so heredocs can contain blank lines:

```go
if lineText == "" || lineText == "\r" {
    out += "\n"
    continue
}
```

`go test ./caddyconfig/caddyfile/` passes (all heredoc cases, including the new blank-line ones and the still-erroring mismatched-whitespace case); `gofmt` is clean. Wider packages couldn't be tested due to no network access for their deps, but the change is isolated to the lexer.
